reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so paying ₹12,990 upfront for a two-person practice when spreadsheets and WhatsApp have worked for ten years feels unjustified. I am deeply skeptical of new software and would only ever test the free pilot before paying double what alternatives charge.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive, and is it truly dead simple enough to warrant abandoning our free spreadsheets and WhatsApp routine?
would_change_my_mind: Pricing competitive with Jamku around ₹6,500 to ₹7,000 a year, or peers at my local study circle confirming it is dead simple and effortlessly saves hours.
